text.en:
The provisions of sections two hundred and seventy-six and two hundred and eighty-four of the
Revised Administrative Code, relative to persons entitled to accrued leave and vacation leave in addition to
accrued leave, respectively, as amended by Act Numbered Thirty-three hundred and seventy-four, are hereby
made applicable to nurses of sanitary divisions who have duly qualified by examination and have been
appointed in accordance with the Civil Service Law.

This Act shall take effect on its approval.
Approved, December 1, 1932.
